parser_family: Genshi markup-stream builder (genshi.input.XMLParser) over CPython 3.14 pyexpat over Expat 2.10.0 in namespace mode; shares the Expat XML parser family with projects/xml/python/xmltodict, untangle, defusedxml, xmlschema, jxmlease and the standard xml.etree.ElementTree path
build_note: Genshi is installed from the pinned py3-none-any wheel (pure Python; genshi/ checked byte-identical to the sdist apart from the optional C speedups source the wheel does not build); it has no runtime dependencies on Python >= 3.9. Ubuntu's CPython 3.14 pyexpat loads Expat 2.10.0 built from source with clang LLVM source coverage (same Expat pin as xmltodict, untangle and jxmlease) through LD_LIBRARY_PATH; pyexpat.EXPAT_VERSION is asserted.
api: genshi.input.XMLParser(BytesIO(bytes of a local XML file), filename) iterated to the end; the documented markup-stream events START (QName, Attrs), END, TEXT, START_NS (prefix, uri), COMMENT and PI are read through QName.namespace/localname
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: Python line tracing of the XMLParser iteration (genshi/input.py, core.py and the stream helpers it calls) and LLVM source coverage of source-built Expat 2.10.0 reached through pyexpat
scope: Valid UTF-8 XML 1.0 local files without DOCTYPE through genshi.input.XMLParser: expanded {uri}local element and attribute names from Genshi's QNames (Expat namespace mode), xmlns declarations counted from START_NS events and the distinct non-empty URIs they bind, attributes sorted per element, maximum depth, and trimmed character and CDATA runs between markup events (comments and processing instructions end a run).
parser_options_caveat: XMLParser's fixed setup was used: Expat namespace mode with '}' separator, buffer_text, parameter-entity parsing ALWAYS and UseForeignDTD with Genshi's own external DTD of HTML entity names, which Expat loads for every document. No DOCTYPE, entity, malformed-input or chunked-input behaviour beyond the controls was tested.
tested_parser: genshi.input.XMLParser creating xml.parsers.expat.ParserCreate(encoding, '}') itself (asserted in the image)
oracle: controls/xml/check_controls.py (expat, namespace-aware shared summary) and the verified lxml/libxml2 path's expected outputs in scripts/verify_python_xml_genshi_feedback.py
